appraisal.description: Self-image, interpretation and expectations, not factual ability.
appraisal.spread: Sparse salient leans; begin from generated lived context or player-confirmed setup. Do not assign by gender, race, class or political party.
appraisal.strength: Repeated voluntary pattern across relevant contexts supports a stronger hold; rank or success does not establish it.
appraisal.conferral: seeded for an already-lived character; player-confirmed for the controlled person; not a claim of an innate infant quality
appraisal.change: Usually slower than manner; sustained revised appraisals and experience can change it. A single compliment or failure is not a forced reversal.

manner.description: How a person expresses or approaches an exchange, not whether they are right.
manner.spread: Choose salient style within a family before descriptors so catalogue synonym counts do not set prevalence. Neutral/unmarked is common; unknown remains unknown.
manner.strength: Consistency in freely chosen behavior, with audience and setting retained.
manner.conferral: seeded for an already-lived character, learned or player-confirmed; situational styles must name their context
manner.change: Relatively adaptable with repeated new interactions and role changes; rehearsing one dialogue does not count as many independent events.

cognition.description: Attention and problem-solving preference, not intelligence, health diagnosis or access to hidden facts.
cognition.spread: Keep curiosity, studying, analysis and imagination independent where their meanings differ; no education or occupation stereotype.
cognition.strength: Pattern across meaningful chosen tasks, after accounting for opportunity and resources.
cognition.conferral: seeded for a lived character or demonstrated later; not a clinical/biological assertion
cognition.change: Change of study/work habits may emerge over sustained practice; a broad processing disposition requires broader evidence than one task.

follow-through.description: Execution and responsibility given actual terms, capacity and competing obligations.
follow-through.spread: No automatic moral penalty for low resources, unemployment, illness, disability or a refused request.
follow-through.strength: Separate promising, beginning, doing and completing; assess feasible commitments and actual reasons for failure.
follow-through.conferral: seeded from coherent generated past or demonstrated later; player-controlled actions remain chosen
follow-through.change: Behaviorally grounded; sustained changed circumstances/practice can move habits. Long history matters but adds no permanent per-change resistance.

motivation.description: What the person gives weight to when selecting feasible goals, not a granted goal outcome.
motivation.spread: Sample compatible priorities sparsely. Wealth is not selfishness and ambition is not competence.
motivation.strength: Repeated prioritization of the same kind of objective, not title or a single forced choice.
motivation.conferral: seeded in already-lived motivations, player-confirmed or shaped by later experience
motivation.change: Depends on changes to aims, roles and lived incentives; an attained goal can alter salience without changing every enduring trait.

relational.description: Orientation toward particular people, obligations and known distress, not a universal relationship outcome.
relational.spread: Keep warmth, trust, concern, honesty and loyalty independent. Some leans apply only to a known bond.
relational.strength: Pattern across relevant interactions. A particular grievance or obligation is stored separately.
relational.conferral: seeded in a coherent lived context or acquired; attachment-specific traits need an attachment
relational.change: Standing toward one person may change before a broad disposition. Reconciliation is not a universal trait rewrite.

pressure.description: Reaction to delay, threat or disagreement; actual stakes and the actor's perception matter.
pressure.spread: Fear, preference for risk and thrill-seeking are distinct. Calmness is not courage or indifference.
pressure.strength: Repeated patterns under comparable but distinct meaningful situations.
pressure.conferral: seeded for lived characters or acquired; never inferred from protected traits or diagnosis
pressure.change: Temporary distress first; enduring change needs subsequent relevant conduct. Do not turn surviving one crisis into a compulsory global trait.

rules: Every original id occurs exactly once in catalogue_assignments. No aliases are claimed merely to reduce the count.
One or two salient adult descriptors are NOT a limit on underlying qualities and NOT permission to redraw a whole personality every context.
Use sparse registered facets and a shared resolver; the scale count is not a number of mandatory UI bars or per-tick numeric updates.
Seeded means created at world initialization for a lived character; it is not evidence of genetic determination or a newborn having adult achievements.
Knowledge, skills, diagnosis, occupation, actual relationship standing and goals are separate. Do not grant them through a trait.

Keep the existing five base axes and IDs. Bind equivalent deliberate/reliability/conflict/risk meanings as aliases to their existing qualified definitions where exact; do not duplicate effects. Existing sociability must be distinguished from private disclosure, shyness and selective closeness.
Proposal scopes in this file describe intended consumers, not verified registered DecisionDeclaration ids. Existing owner maps actual scope/option keys before effect admission.
Private calibration is allowed and must be separately labelled. This response supplies relative rules, not 121 arbitrary numerical constants.
Opposite-end mapping is content preparation, not permission to flatten or remove meanings the owner requested.

existing_store_evidence.finding: The existing canonical mind catalogue permits one or more expressions; curiosity, loyalty and ambition are already declared with one expression. The stricter two-pole requirement lives in trait-packs.ts, not in the underlying whole-world store.
existing_store_evidence.receiving: Prefer a small explicit one-sided declaration/value policy in the existing trait-pack adapter. Keep the plain unmarked counterpart supplied here for compatibility; do not falsely pair independent traits or rebuild the mind store.
